title: Seazn relay job, v1: the Machine's session facts and heartbeat
description: The web↔Machine contract for a relay session (compositor spec 2026-10-14 §5.3, §5.4). The root is bare: validate against #/$defs/session (the GET's data), #/$defs/heartbeat (the POST body) and #/$defs/heartbeatReply (the POST's data). On the wire a 200 is the house envelope `{ "ok": true, "data": … }` and this shape is its `data`; every refusal is `{ "ok": false, … }` with its status. Inside the Machine, the overlay page reads the compositor's loopback phase endpoint: #/$defs/phaseReply is its reply and #/$defs/phaseEndpoint where it listens (overlay templates spec 2026-10-15 §4.3). Vendored into the compositor repo (C07); its sha256, parity with its zod twins and its fixtures are pinned by apps/web/src/server/api-v1/__tests__/relay-contract.test.ts.

session.description: GET /api/internal/relay/sessions/{sid} with `Authorization: Bearer <job token>`: the facts a Machine boots from (compositor spec 2026-10-14 §5.3; web `sessionFactsForJob`). On the wire a 200 is the house envelope `{ "ok": true, "data": … }` and this shape is its `data`; every refusal is `{ "ok": false, … }` with its status. Strict: no other key. A refused token is 401 (one body for every cause), an unknown session 404, a terminal one 410 with code SESSION_ENDED. The four composed-only keys (input, output, heartbeatIntervalMs, overlayUrl) are absent on a passthrough session; a compositor refuses any session that is not composed or lacks one of them.

sessionId.description: The broadcast session: the Machine's SESSION_ID.

fixtureId.description: The fixture the session broadcasts. null once that fixture has been deleted mid-session: the session outlives it and ends through the normal commands (V410 `on delete set null`).

themeId.description: The overlay theme picked at Go live, or null for the default theme.

overlayDelayMs.description: How far the score overlay runs behind real time, in milliseconds, fixed for the session when it is created: the fixture's override, or else the measured camera-to-compositor delay (ADR 0006; web config.ts RELAY_OVERLAY_DELAY_DEFAULT_MS). 0 is a real value, never "unset". On a composed session it must agree with the `delay=` in overlayUrl.

maxDurationMinutes.description: The session's own duration cap. A Machine's deadline authority is RELAY_DEADLINE_AT (env), not this.

target.description: Where the Machine pushes. Passthrough: the organiser's destination. Composed: Cloudflare Input B's RTMPS ingest, never the destination itself (§5.3, R2004).

url.description: The RTMP(S) ingest URL, without the key.

streamKey.description: The stream key. A credential: never logged, never in argv, never formatted into an error.

pageToken.description: A relay-page token for this session: the overlay page's credential. Never logged.

input.description: Composed only: Cloudflare Input A slot 0's SRT playback, the camera the compositor reads (§5.3, R2004).

url.description: srt://host:port and nothing else: no path, no query, no userinfo. The stream id and the passphrase travel as their own fields.

streamId.description: The SRT stream id. A credential.

output.description: Composed only: the programme encode. 720p30 (1280×720, 30 fps, 4000 kbps) by default, 1080p30 (1920×1080, 30 fps, 6000 kbps) when flagged (compositor ADR 0005). A compositor refuses any other profile.

heartbeatIntervalMs.description: Composed only: how often the Machine POSTs its heartbeat, in milliseconds (§5.3; web config.ts RELAY_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS).

overlayUrl.description: Composed only: the score overlay page the compositor renders, {APP_URL}/overlay/fixtures/{fixtureId}?sid={sessionId}&st={pageToken}&host=compositor&delay={overlayDelayMs} (R2004). It carries the page token, so it is logged only with its query removed. Its `delay=` appears exactly once and equals overlayDelayMs: the server never serves, and a compositor refuses, a session whose overlayUrl has no `delay=`, has it twice, or has a different value. Neither number is defaulted from the other.

heartbeat.description: POST /api/internal/relay/sessions/{sid}/heartbeat with `Authorization: Bearer <job token>`, every heartbeatIntervalMs (compositor spec 2026-10-14 §5.3): the Machine's report, and the control channel. The body is bare (no envelope). Strict: an unknown key is a 400, never dropped. Every field but `state` is optional. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero. null is admitted and stored as sent, but a compositor omits a field rather than sending null. The server keeps the whole latest body and every beat as a sample. The 200 is `{ "ok": true, "data": <heartbeatReply> }`; 400 a body this schema refuses; 401 a refused token; 404 an unknown session; 410 SESSION_ENDED.

state.description: starting | playing | stalled | stopped. `playing` means the output is connected, whether it carries a slate or the camera (owner ruling 2026-10-14); the camera's own state is in programmePhase and input.

videoState.description: R1's video state word, verbatim, at most 40 characters. The compositor does not send it.

fps.description: Programme frames per second. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero.

bitrateKbps.description: Output bitrate, kbit/s. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero.

egressBytes.description: Bytes the output has sent since the Machine started, a whole number. Omitted when not measured: an omitted value leaves the stored count unchanged, and only a reported 0 stores 0.

measuredLatencyMs.description: Measured latency, whole milliseconds. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero.

droppedFrames.description: Frames dropped (the compositor: encoder overruns that stepped the ladder), a whole number. A present 0 is a measured zero.

encoderSpeed.description: Encoder speed, 1.0 is real time. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero.

cpuPct.description: Machine CPU, percent. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero.

memMb.description: Machine memory, MB. Omitted when not measured, never sent as 0: a present 0 is a measured zero.

programmePhase.description: The programme (compositor C03, C06): `waiting` before the first camera frame, `live`, `frozen` after 0.5 s with no frame, `reconnecting` (the slate) after 3 s. Back to `live` after 1 s of continuous frames. `final` is the final hold (compositor C06 `Holding`, its 2026-10-15 amendment; overlay templates spec 2026-10-15 §4.2): the compositor enters it on the FIRST end request (an `ending` heartbeat reply, a SIGINT, which is web's organiser and deadline stop, or its own deadline, RELAY_DEADLINE_AT) and shows the Final scene for FINAL_HOLD_MS before it drains and sends EOS. A later end request keeps the first one's clock. It is terminal and wins over every camera state, and the exit beat after a hold carries it too. A SIGTERM that arrives before any hold (the platform's controlled stop) drains at once with no hold, so that exit beat does not carry `final`.

input.description: The camera link, the SRT read of Input A (compositor C04): connecting, connected, or backoff between retries.

output.description: The programme push to Input B (compositor C04): connecting, connected, or backoff between retries.

graphics.description: The score overlay renderer (compositor C05): starting, ready, restarting, or failed (the camera goes out without the overlay).

inputKicks.description: How many times the camera's playback was closed under the compositor within the kick window (5 minutes). A present 0 is a measured zero.

inputKickAlert.description: true once inputKicks exceeds the alert count (more than 3 in 5 minutes): a second reader or Cloudflare maintenance.

pipelineRebuilds.description: Camera pipeline builds after the first, since the process started. A present 0 is a measured zero.

sinkSwaps.description: Output pipeline builds after the first, since the process started. A present 0 is a measured zero.

rung.description: The degrade ladder's rung (compositor C05): full, or overlay_half_rate, the bottom, where the overlay is refreshed at half rate. The score is never removed (owner ruling 2026-10-18), so the ladder has no lower rung, and the bottom holds: the compositor never steps back up (a restarted process starts on full). Anything but full means the encoder overran and the ladder stepped down: the Machine is short of CPU, and the server raises a sizing alarm.

scoreStale.description: true while the overlay page cannot reach the score feed (it keeps the last score). Omitted until the page has reported either way.

phaseChannel.description: Which channel the overlay page reads the programme phase from (overlay templates spec 2026-10-15 §4.3): `loopback`, the compositor's own endpoint (#/$defs/phaseEndpoint, the primary), or `web`, the fallback that reads programmePhase from the session's latest beat through the page's data poll (the page switches after 3 failed loopback attempts). Omitted until the page has reported.

exitReason.description: Sent only with `state: "stopped"`, on the final beat: why the Machine is exiting (compositor C06 `ExitReason`). ended, deadline, signalled and session_gone exit 0; refused exits 78; fatal exits 70; restart exits 75 (the compositor restarts itself in place: the host restarts the process on the same Machine, and the server records the beat and does not count it as a crash). A beat in any other state that carries exitReason or exitDetail is refused (400); this schema states it as its if/then. The server records the reason with the beat; the runner's observed exit stays the authority for how the session ends.

exitDetail.description: Sent only with `state: "stopped"`, on the final beat: what went wrong, in words. The server's bound is 200 UTF-16 code units. This schema's maxLength counts characters (code points), and a character is at most two UTF-16 code units, so it publishes 100 characters: a text within that is never refused. Redacted by the compositor before it is sent (no key, token or query). The server scrubs it again before storing it (anything JWT-shaped, the session's own job token, everything from the first `?`), and both stores keep the same text. Human text, never parsed.

heartbeatReply.description: The `data` of a heartbeat's 200 (compositor spec 2026-10-14 §5.3): what the Machine must do. A Machine takes no inbound traffic, so this reply is the only way a stop reaches it, and the only way web can tell it the phone is back.

desiredState.description: "live": keep going. "ending": flush, send EOS and exit 0.

phoneLiveEdge.description: The session's phone-live edge counter (Owed 108 fix b): web adds 1 each time the session's phone goes from not-live back to live, after it had been live before, so a Machine waiting out its input's reconnect back-off can reconnect at once. Act once per INCREASE of the value you have seen, and treat an increase as a hint: never rebuild an input still receiving frames (latch it and act only at a stall). Web raises it from the phone's own beats, including after the phone had gone silent for the not-responding window (about 30 s), so a web outage of 30 s or more, which silences the phone-to-web leg while video keeps flowing, raises it on every live session at once; that guard absorbs it. The first-ever live is not an edge (the counter first appears at 0). Monotonic for the life of the session and stored by web, so it survives a restart of web or of the Machine. Served on every reply once it exists, so a repeat is not news. Absent, or null (a reader treats both alike), means unknown: the session has no phone, or its phone has not been live yet.

phaseReply.description: GET http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}?after=<seq> (#/$defs/phaseEndpoint) inside the Machine: the compositor's loopback reply, which the overlay page reads when its URL carries host=compositor (overlay templates spec 2026-10-15 §4.3). Served by the compositor, not web, so it is bare JSON with no envelope. `?after=<seq>` long-polls: the request is held at most longPollMaxMs. Strict: no other key.

phase.description: The programme phase, in heartbeat.programmePhase's words.

seq.description: The phase's sequence number, a whole number, never negative. A reader passes the last one it saw as `after`.

phaseEndpoint.description: Where the compositor's phase endpoint listens (overlay templates spec 2026-10-15 §4.3). Not a message: three constants, each published as a const. Web declares them in lib/relay-phase.ts, and a vendoring repo drift-tests its own copies against this file (C12). Loopback only (127.0.0.1) inside the Machine: never exposed outside it, and not part of the outbound-only host contract (compositor ADR 0007). The page is https and the endpoint is loopback, so the compositor answers the preflight with `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true` and a CORS origin locked to the app's exact origin.

port.description: The TCP port on 127.0.0.1. Unprivileged (above 1023) and below Linux's default ephemeral range (32768–60999), so no outbound socket is handed it first.

longPollMaxMs.description: The longest a long-poll is held, in milliseconds.
